brief.meaningEn: Become so entangled in others’ expectations that one’s choices are driven by that pressure.
brief.meaningZh: 深受別人期望牽制，令自己的選擇被那股壓力帶動。
brief.grammar: Be/get caught up in social pressure; not the different catch up with someone (reach the same pace) of canonical 1521. Name the expectation and choice it affects.
brief.register: Neutral conversational or advisory English. A youth worker may use it when discussing online comparison with a student.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有別人的期望或比較如何影響決定的證據；單純知道流行趨勢而自行選擇，不等於被社交壓力牽着走。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是趕上功課進度，也不表示每個人都無法拒絕同儕要求。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出壓力來源、受影響的選擇及重新衡量自身需要的做法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 39, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Teenagers can become caught up in social pressure online.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: Tara enjoyed painting, but every friend in her feed posted costly fashion hauls. She nearly spent her art-course savings to match them, then realised she was caught up in social pressure and kept the course money.
listening.zh: 塔拉喜歡繪畫，但社交平台朋友都分享昂貴服飾戰利品。她差點花掉美術課儲蓄來跟上，後來發現自己被社交壓力牽着走，保留了課程費。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼顯示壓力影響決定？

options.en: She nearly used course savings to match friends’ posts.
options.zh: 她差點動用課程儲蓄來跟朋友貼文看齊。

options.en: She independently needed new art tools for class.
options.zh: 她本來就因上課需要新畫具。

options.en: She never saw what friends posted.
options.zh: 她從沒看過朋友貼文。

options.en: She was catching up on a late assignment.
options.zh: 她正在趕上遲交功課。

listening.explanationZh: 朋友展示影響原本的儲蓄選擇。

reply.promptEn: Several classmates buy expensive event tickets to avoid feeling excluded. Kim would rather save for a bicycle but feels pushed to buy one too. What can she say before deciding?
reply.promptZh: （幾名同學為免被排除而買昂貴活動門票。阿金本想儲錢買單車，卻感到被推着也買票。她決定前可怎樣說？）

options.en: I should separate my own goal from the group expectation.
options.zh: 我應把自己的目標與團體期望分開。

options.en: Buying the ticket would use money set aside for my bicycle.
options.zh: 買票會用掉原本儲來買單車的錢。

options.en: I may be caught up in social pressure.
options.zh: 我可能被社交壓力牽着走。

options.en: I can consider whether the event matters to me personally.
options.zh: 我可以想想活動對我本人是否重要。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均針對同儕期望與個人目標。

scene.promptZh: 一名學生本想參加攝影班，但見同學都報昂貴旅行後，差點也報名，只為不被排除。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The student is caught up in social pressure.
options.zh: 學生被社交壓力牽着走。

options.en: The student is catching up on missed homework.
options.zh: 學生正追趕缺交的功課。

options.en: The student independently chose the trip for its itinerary.
options.zh: 學生只因行程而自行選旅行。

scene.explanationZh: 同儕期望推動偏離原來目標的決定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 someone is caught up in social pressure？

options.en: A learner compares options, chooses the music class they already wanted and feels free to decline friends’ different choice.
options.zh: 學員比較選項，選原本想上的音樂課，也能自在拒絕朋友的不同選擇。

options.en: A teenager buys a costly item mainly to avoid classmates’ criticism.
options.zh: 少年主要為免同學批評而買昂貴物品。

options.en: A student abandons a preferred club because everyone in the group expects another choice.
options.zh: 學生因同儕都期待另一選擇而放棄喜歡的社團。

contrast.explanationZh: 獨立而自在的選擇不顯示被壓力牽制。

dialogue.promptEn: A: I was going to keep my savings for lessons, but all my friends say I need the same new phone or I will look out of place. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：我本想儲錢上課，但朋友都說我須買同款新電話，否則會格格不入。乙：______）

options.en: Their expectations are pulling against your own plan.
options.zh: 他們的期望與你原有計劃相衝。

options.en: You can weigh the phone against the lessons you wanted.
options.zh: 你可以比較電話與原本想上的課。

options.en: You may be caught up in social pressure.
options.zh: 你可能被社交壓力牽着走。

options.en: You do not have to decide just to avoid their comments.
options.zh: 你不必只為免受評論而決定。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句點出同儕期望的作用。

speaking.en: Arun almost changed his subject choice because his friends mocked the course he wanted; he recognised he was caught up in social pressure and asked the adviser about his own goals.
speaking.zh: 朋友嘲笑阿倫想選的科目，他差點改選；他發現自己被社交壓力牽着走，於是向輔導員談自己的目標。
speaking.promptZh: 指出期望、受影響決定及重新評估。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩人各因群體期望而差點放棄本來重視的選擇，之後重新衡量。用英文寫出壓力和行動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 不可把所有受朋友影響都寫成不能自主；需有具體選擇受到牽制。

examples.en: Nia was caught up in social pressure when her club friends pushed her to buy matching gear, so she checked the actual rules and kept her repair budget.
examples.zh: 社團朋友催妮雅買同款裝備，她被社交壓力牽着走；後來她查實際規則，保留維修預算。

examples.en: After classmates mocked his quiet weekend plan, Dev got caught up in social pressure and nearly booked a costly trip; he chose the volunteer shift he had already committed to.
examples.zh: 同學嘲笑德夫安靜的週末安排後，他被社交壓力牽着走，差點訂昂貴旅行；最後他選擇先前承諾的義工班次。

takeaways.en: Caught up in social pressure means letting others’ expectations drive a choice.
takeaways.zh: caught up in social pressure 指讓別人的期望左右選擇。

takeaways.en: Someone caught up in social pressure can still pause and reconsider.
takeaways.zh: 被社交壓力牽着走的人仍可停下重新考慮。

brief.meaningEn: Become widely noticed or popular very quickly, especially online.
brief.meaningZh: 在很短時間內迅速受到廣泛注意或走紅，尤其在網上。
brief.grammar: Blow up overnight; subject is a person, post or work that gains attention. Overnight is figurative for rapid change, not necessarily one literal night; distinct from canonical 61 simple overnight timing.
brief.register: Informal contemporary English. A creator may use it when discussing a sudden jump in views with a friend.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有短時間內明顯的大幅關注增長；只增加幾名熟人觀眾或作品真的爆炸，不是此義。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不保證關注持久或有收入，也不一定是製作者毫無準備。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出原有曝光、迅速上升的可見資料，以及尚未確定的持續效果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 46, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: An unknown artist can blow up overnight online.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: A small ceramics page usually had a few dozen views. After a museum shared one repair video, it reached hundreds of thousands in two days. The clip blew up overnight, though orders remained modest.
listening.zh: 一個小陶瓷頁面平日只有數十觀看次數。博物館轉發一段修復影片後，兩天內達數十萬觀看。短片迅速爆紅，雖然訂單仍不多。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼支持 blew up overnight？

options.en: Views rose from dozens to hundreds of thousands in two days.
options.zh: 兩天內觀看次數由數十升至數十萬。

options.en: Orders immediately matched every view.
options.zh: 訂單立即與每次觀看相等。

options.en: The video was physically damaged by an explosion.
options.zh: 影片真的被爆炸毀壞。

options.en: The page had the same small audience for months.
options.zh: 頁面數月以來觀眾數目完全不變。

listening.explanationZh: 關注短時間急升，不等於收入急升。

reply.promptEn: A student’s repair tutorial had forty regular viewers. A large learning channel linked it, and by the next morning thousands had watched and shared it. How might the student describe the change?
reply.promptZh: （學生的維修教學平日有四十名觀眾。大型教學頻道連結它，翌晨已有數千人觀看和分享。學生可怎樣形容？）

options.en: The audience grew extremely quickly.
options.zh: 觀眾極速增加。

options.en: The channel link brought wider attention.
options.zh: 頻道連結帶來更廣泛注意。

options.en: The tutorial blew up overnight.
options.zh: 教學影片一夜爆紅。

options.en: The new reach does not yet prove long-term demand.
options.zh: 新增曝光尚未證明長期需求。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據短時間觀看暴增。

scene.promptZh: 本來只有數十人聽的樂曲，經知名主持分享後一天內獲數十萬次播放。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The song blew up overnight.
options.zh: 歌曲迅速爆紅。

options.en: The studio suffered a physical explosion.
options.zh: 錄音室真的爆炸。

options.en: The song has certainly earned the artist a stable income.
options.zh: 歌曲肯定已為歌手帶來穩定收入。

scene.explanationZh: 播放量急升是關注爆發，不保證收益。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 a post blew up overnight？

options.en: A post gains three extra views over six months and remains within the creator’s small circle.
options.zh: 貼文六個月只多三次觀看，仍只在製作者的小圈子流傳。

options.en: A clip moves from a few views to a large audience in a day.
options.zh: 短片一天內由少量觀看擴至大量觀眾。

options.en: An unknown drawing spreads rapidly after a gallery shares it.
options.zh: 原本無人認識的畫被畫廊分享後迅速流傳。

contrast.explanationZh: 少量而緩慢增加不屬突然爆紅。

dialogue.promptEn: A: Our local history clip usually gets thirty views, but after the archive shared it yesterday, twenty thousand people have watched it. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：我們的地方歷史短片平日有三十次觀看，但檔案館昨天分享後，已有兩萬人看過。乙：______）

options.en: That is a sudden rise in reach.
options.zh: 曝光突然上升。

options.en: The archive seems to have introduced it to a much larger audience.
options.zh: 檔案館似乎把它帶給更多觀眾。

options.en: It really blew up overnight.
options.zh: 它真的一夜爆紅。

options.en: We can watch whether the new attention lasts.
options.zh: 我們可以觀察新關注會否持續。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句概括短期關注急升。

speaking.en: The choir’s rehearsal clip blew up overnight after a school network shared it, but the members waited to see whether viewers would also attend the concert.
speaking.zh: 學校網絡分享合唱團綵排短片後，短片迅速爆紅，但團員仍等着看觀眾會否到音樂會。
speaking.promptZh: 區分急升觀看與未證實的持續行動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩份原本只有小眾觀眾的作品在短時間內大幅走紅。用英文寫出原基線、增長和限制。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例不可把短期曝光寫成保證長期成功。

examples.en: The neighbourhood map blew up overnight after a travel account shared it: weekly downloads jumped from fifty to ten thousand, although future use was unknown.
examples.zh: 旅遊帳號分享社區地圖後，它迅速爆紅：每週下載由五十跳至一萬，雖然未來使用仍未確定。

examples.en: A volunteer’s sign-language lesson blew up overnight when a national museum linked it; views climbed from a few hundred to forty thousand, but she had not yet planned a series.
examples.zh: 國家博物館連結一名義工的手語課後，影片迅速爆紅：觀看由數百升至四萬，但她尚未計劃系列。

takeaways.en: Blow up overnight means gain wide attention very fast.
takeaways.zh: blow up overnight 指極短時間內獲得廣泛注意。

takeaways.en: A post that blows up overnight may not keep that audience.
takeaways.zh: 一夜爆紅的貼文未必能留住觀眾。
